Do EXACTLY this, nothing more:
1. Read .skippy/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and pick the FIRST unchecked '- [ ]' task.
2. Read ONLY the files that task names — their CONTENTS are ALREADY PROVIDED above in the TASK FILES section. Trust the task description; it contains the API details you need.
3. Implement that ONE task with direct edits (edit_text_file for existing files, write_text_file for new ones). Never use subagents. Start writing by your third action at the latest.
4. Verify deterministically: run the task's attached '- verify:' command if it has one, otherwise the exact test command the task names. The harness re-runs that command after your turn and REVERTS the checkbox if it fails — a checkmark you did not earn costs the loop and gets annotated in the plan.
5. Use edit_text_file on .skippy/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md to change that task's '- [ ]' to '- [x]' ONLY if verification passed. Change NOTHING else on that line: the task TITLE is an identifier the harness matches byte-for-byte, so rewriting or expanding it makes the task unmatchable and the run stalls forever (2026-07-31: a title rewritten into a 1000-character command blob cost four loops). Never delete or edit a task's indented metadata lines (verify/files/verify-failed). If a task needs clarification, add a NEW indented 'note:' line under it — never touch the title.
6. Respond with a one-paragraph report that STARTS with exactly one status token: DONE (task finished, verification ran and passed) | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS <the concern> | NEEDS_CONTEXT <what is missing> | BLOCKED <why>. Then: which task, what changed, how verified.
7. If the task you just checked is the LAST unchecked one: before reporting, run the gate command (test -f RESEARCH-orca.md && grep -q 'NOT borrowing' RESEARCH-orca.md && grep -q 'read their code' RESEARCH-orca.md) and fix what it reports. The harness runs the same gate immediately after your turn, so a failure found now costs nothing and a failure found later costs a whole loop.
You may respond with exactly DONE-ALL-CRITERIA-MET only when EVERY box in .skippy/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md is already '- [x]' — never while any '- [ ]' remains; a false DONE claim is detected mechanically and wastes the loop.

     8	orchestration product; this repo is a headless, local-first MCP control
     9	plane. They overlap in intent and differ in architecture, which is exactly
    10	what makes the comparison useful.
    11
